name: overrun_ends_with_the_turn_the_damaged_attacker_survives_the_cleanup
notes: Printed: 'Creatures you control get +3/+3 and gain trample until end of turn.' Seat 0's 2/2 attacker (5/5 after Overrun) is blocked by seat 1's 4/1 and takes 4 damage. At the cleanup step the damage wears off and the +3/+3 ends at the same time (CR 514.2), so the attacker, now a 2/2 again, is still on the battlefield with no damage. In seat 1's turn every creature of seat 0 is back to its printed size: the attacker 2/2, the home creature 1/1, the late arrival 1/1, with no damage left anywhere.
